choice.basis: The chart titled 'Smartphone Market Share in Europe' (chart_1) displays four labeled slices: Samsung (55%), Xiaomi (20%), Apple (15%), and Others (10%). The task asks to identify the 'current market leader,' which corresponds to the brand with the greatest displayed market share. Comparing the labeled percentages, Samsung's 55% is the largest value. Therefore, Samsung is the current market leader.
choice.option_label: Select Samsung as the current market leader
